verdict.rationale: ADK is a framework, not an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. First-party docs show how to build your own MCP server that wraps ADK tools so any MCP client can use them [google-adk-docs-5, google-adk-docs-18]. This is a documented DIY pattern rather than a shipped, ready-to-connect official server. The 'AI-aware developer resources' line [google-adk-docs-9] never says MCP, and ADK acting as an MCP client is a different role, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: a shipped or hosted official ADK MCP server (no package, endpoint or command is documented), connection/setup instructions for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
